name: toolsenabled-sim
description: Deterministic offline warehouse robot simulation with shared MCP control, delivery guidance and replay.

connection_file.title: Assigned robot connection file
connection_file.description: Absolute path to the private connection file created by the running Sim hub for this agent. Keep the hub outside the plugin cache.

run_root.title: Retained run root (optional)
run_root.description: Absolute path to the private hub root on this OS account, for read-only history after shutdown. Never a connection-file directory for another agent.
